name: niri
summary: niri prohibits using LLMs to create pull request code, issue descriptions, comments and public reviews; those must be human-written. LLM translation of human-written text is allowed only if the original text is also provided.

evidence.quote: All pull request code (including tests), issue descriptions, comments, public reviews, etc. must be human-written.
You may use LLMs for *translating* your human-written text; in this case you must also provide the original text to reduce the chance of miscommunication.
